description: This file defines the class Vtiger_PDF_FooterViewer, which manages the rendering of footer content in PDF documents within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for setting footer display options and generating the footer layout.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_FooterViewer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering PDF footers, with configurable options for footer display on every page or only the last page.

methods.name: setOnEveryPage
methods.description: Configures the footer to appear on every page.

methods.name: onEveryPage
methods.description: Checks if footer is set to appear on every page.

methods.name: setOnLastPage
methods.description: Configures the footer to appear only on the last page.

methods.name: onLastPage
methods.description: Checks if footer is set to appear on the last page.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Sets the data model for the footer content.

methods.name: totalHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the footer based on content and page settings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the footer content in the PDF.
